programme.title: The Weather Files
programme.desc: A fisherman becomes trapped on a lake during a hurricane; a hurricane chaser saves lives in the Philippines; an explorer becomes trapped during Hurricane Katrina.

programme.title: Wild Winter
programme.desc: In the unforgiving, enduring darkness of the Arctic, it's a challenge to stay alive; some skilled predators use the punishing conditions to their advantage, to not only survive, but to thrive.

programme.title: Plastic Earth
programme.desc: Scientists, engineers, researchers and innovators tackle solutions to deal with the problems of worldwide plastic production from fossil-based sources, including climate change, pollution and environmental issues.

programme.title: Defenders of the Wild

programme.title: The Humboldt Current
programme.desc: In Chile's Torres del Paine, melt from snow-covered mountains feeds finger-like fjords as they reach out to the sea to join the current, lowering its salinity and becoming home to wading birds, rare dolphins and orcas.

programme.title: The Humboldt Current
programme.desc: As we follow our female blue whale north, we arrive in central Chile; the influence of the Humboldt current shapes life even in one of the driest ecosystems on earth.

programme.title: The Humboldt Current
programme.desc: The current is followed by a unique population of Chilean blue whales and is the last refuge for other extremely rare marine mammals.
